description: This file contains an in-memory implementation of the IMembershipTable interface for testing purposes within the Orleans distributed computing framework. It manages membership entries, versioning, and provides methods for simulating table operations such as read, insert, update, and cleanup of silo membership data.

classes.name: InMemoryMembershipTable
classes.description: A test implementation of the IMembershipTable interface that stores membership entries in memory, supporting operations like insert, update, read, and cleanup for testing purposes within Orleans.

methods.name: InMemoryMembershipTable
methods.description: Default constructor for creating an empty membership table.

methods.name: InMemoryMembershipTable
methods.description: Constructor initializing the membership table with a specific version and set of entries.

methods.name: ClearCalls
methods.description: Clears the record of method calls.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the entries and advances the version.

methods.name: CleanupDefunctSiloEntries
methods.description: Removes entries of silos marked as dead before a certain date.

methods.name: DeleteMembershipTableEntries
methods.description: Logs the deletion of all membership entries for a given cluster ID.

methods.name: InitializeMembershipTable
methods.description: Logs the initialization of the membership table, optionally trying to initialize version info.

methods.name: InsertRow
methods.description: Inserts a new membership entry if one for the same silo address does not already exist.

methods.name: ReadAll
methods.description: Returns all membership entries and the current version.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Retrieves the membership entry for a specific silo address.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Updates the last alive timestamp for a specific silo entry.

methods.name: UpdateRow
methods.description: Updates an existing membership entry if the etag matches and version is increased.

methods.name: ValidateVersion
methods.description: Checks that the provided TableVersion has the same etag and is higher than current version.
